subject: Request to Reschedule Live-Fire Iterations
addressees: Commander, 4th Infantry Division, 1633 Mekong Street, Fort Carson, CO  80913-4321

paragraphs.text: Request endorsement to direct subordinate battalions to reschedule live-fire iterations before 25 July 2026 because Range 14 closes for maintenance from 3 August 2026 through 7 August 2026.
Range Control will replace target lifters on lanes 1 through 12 and repair the berm on the north impact area during the closure.
My point of contact for this action is Mr. David Okonkwo, ATZB-RC, at 719-555-0142 or david.a.okonkwo.civ@army.mil.
